question: How do I enroll in a course on Student Hub?
answer: Navigate to the Courses page, browse the catalog, and click the 'ENROLL' button on any course card. Your enrollment will be immediately linked to your student profile.

question: Are the online courses self-paced or live?
answer: Most of our courses are hybrid. They include pre-recorded video lectures and hands-on coding exercises, plus optional weekly live Q&A sessions with the instructors.

question: How do I change or customize my profile picture?
answer: Click the circular avatar icon in the top-right corner of any page. You can upload an image from your computer, choose an illustrated avatar, or paste an image URL.

question: What are the requirements for semester scholarships?
answer: Undergraduate students enrolled in a full-time degree program with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.75 and good academic standing are eligible for merit scholarships.

question: How can I access digital books in the online library?
answer: Click 'Library' in the top navigation bar. You will find thousands of categorized e-books, research publications, and journals accessible with your student credentials.

question: Can I get a refund if I withdraw from a course?
answer: Yes, you can receive a 100% refund within the first 7 days of course enrollment, provided you have not completed more than 20% of the course modules.

question: How do I register for campus hackathons and workshops?
answer: Visit the Events section, find the event you want to attend, and check the available seat capacity and date. Register directly through the event link.

question: Where can I view my registered courses and attendance?
answer: You can view your active courses by clicking the shopping/cart icon in the header or visiting the 'Completed Courses' page from your profile dropdown.

question: What should I do if I forget my login password?
answer: Go to the Login page and click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your registered email address to receive a secure password reset link.

question: How do I contact student grievance or technical support?
answer: Click 'CONTACT US' in the page footer or email support@studenthub.edu. Our campus tech desk is available Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM.

question: Can I participate in multiple campus student clubs?
answer: Yes! Students can join up to 3 clubs per semester to balance extracurricular engagement with their academic coursework.

question: How do I receive course completion certificates?
answer: Upon completing 100% of the lessons and passing the final assessment quiz with at least 70%, your verified certificate is generated in PDF format.
